explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/373: n! = a₁!⋯a_k! with n−1 > a₁ ≥ ⋯ ≥ a_k ≥ 2 has only finitely many solutions. S consists of pairs (n, l) with l non-increasing, all entries > 1, head < n − 1 and n! = ∏ a_i!. The empty list cannot occur, since it would force n ≤ 1 and then head 0 < n − 1 fails. Finiteness of S is the statement. Faithful.
